results.content: An August 25 Economist/YouGov poll found 35 percent of Americans approved of the president's job performance, with a net approval rating of -26. Compared to a similar poll during the same point in his first term, his net approval rating was -9 and former Democratic President Joe Biden’s -12. [...] Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 28, leaving him underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 126,586 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term.

results.content:
The most recent polling data from The Economist and YouGov, taken August 21-28 found that 36 percent of Hispanic voters approved of how Trump is handling his job.

It is a 13-point increase from May 22-26, when 23 percent approved of the president’s job performance, according to polling. It is a further 5-point increase from polling data recorded July 25-27, when 31 percent of Hispanic voters approved of the president. The number was slightly higher, 34 percent, in poll data taken June 26-29.
results.title: Donald Trump approval rating with Hispanics shifts direction
